parsed.title: Your best work is hiding in your camera roll
parsed.hook: Your camera roll knows the job happened. The customer searching your name does not.
parsed.angle: Turn each finished job into visible proof with a repeatable before-during-after photo habit.
parsed.caption:
Word of mouth may put your name in someone’s phone.

Then your public record has to back it up.

Try a three-photo habit on every job:

Before: one wide shot from a clear angle.

During: one detail that shows the work people rarely see.

After: the finished work from the original angle.

Nothing fancy. No photo shoot. Just a record that lets the work speak after the truck leaves.

#OwnerOperator #TradeCrew #JobsiteProof
parsed.cta: On the next job, take all three shots before you load up.
parsed.alt_text: A five-part instructional carousel showing a simple jobsite photo routine: capture one wide photo before work, one detail during the work, and the finished result from the original angle, then save the set together.

slides.headline: Your best work is hiding
slides.body:
Your camera roll knows the job happened.

The customer searching your name does not.

slides.headline: Take the before shot
slides.body:
Stand back.

Pick one clear angle that shows the full starting point.

slides.headline: Show the hidden work
slides.body:
Capture one useful detail during the job.

The part that gets covered up is often the part worth showing.

slides.headline: Return to the same angle
slides.body:
Take the finished shot from where you started.

Make the change easy to see.

slides.headline: Make three photos part of cleanup
slides.body:
Before. During. After.

Save the set before the tools go back in the truck.

evidence.claim: A referral can lead to an online search rather than directly to a call.
evidence.quote: Your customer tells her neighbor about the deck, the neighbor takes your name, and then she does exactly what you'd do: pulls out her phone.

evidence.claim: Photos of actual local work can strengthen the public record people see.
evidence.quote: A Google profile with a real star rating, recent reviews, photos of actual local work, and calm answers to the people who complained: that's a green light.

evidence.claim: The source recommends a before-during-after photo habit on every job.
evidence.quote: The three-photo habit. Before, during, after, on every job.
